specs.metric: realised annual fee or price/mix change

threshold_basis.rule: Fire when a realised annual fee or price/mix change above zero is recorded. The 2026-10-28 Hohn evidence note says the pricing-power objection lapses only once B3 shows a realised fee increase. Zero is that boundary, not an inflation hurdle. A hit means an increase was observed.
